title: Sized to your *wrist*
hero_alt: The 4082 Ciselé bracelet beside loose Lune beads and a Ciselé twist ring on teal suede
dek: How we fit a beaded bracelet, one bead at a time.

body.html: A beaded bracelet should move on the wrist without sliding over the hand. Because ours are strung from separate parts, we can fit each one closely.
We measure your wrist with a soft tape just above the wrist bone, then add a little room so the bracelet can turn. Most people like about a centimetre of ease; some prefer a closer fit.
To lengthen a bracelet, we add beads or pipes from the same design; to shorten it, we take them out, keeping the pattern even. It usually takes a few minutes while you wait, and there is no charge.
